Round 333 is planned and the decision is **CONTINUE**. It is stage c2b-ii of PERF-DRAG-PREVIEW, on top of `de28cca`, the commit gate 332 published.

**Round 332 result.** C passed it with a real browser check and found no bugs, and the gate published it. That stage (overview and meter) is now done in the backlog (v292), and the old gate-331 Lows S1–S3 are closed.
- A's reviewer called the full-`Arrangement` overview prop a latent Medium. I re-rated it to an info signal, because C and the gate reviewer both found no way it fails today. It goes to the open architecture checkpoint D-29z915.
- A's loop-toggle Low becomes a named row in the regression round. A's other Lows go to `deferred_low_polish`.

**Why not the regression round.** `regression-last` is 2026-11-02, so today is only day 2 and the rule triggers at 3. The previous plan assumed round 333 would be planned on 2026-11-05, which didn't happen. D-29z988 records the correction: the regression round is the first one planned on or after 2026-11-05.

**What round 333 changes** (`current-task.md`). In `ArrangementDetailPanel.tsx`, the layout effect that copies the clip start/end into the editable Start/End fields becomes a render-time check, the same pattern the Clip Gain field already uses. That removes the extra commit on every trim, move or range drag. Nothing on screen or in the sound changes.
- A applies my patch `b-round-332/sketch/sketch.patch.txt` (2 files, 10 new tests DP33–DP42) and edits doc 232 by hand. A must run the real code-reviewer, because 3 files change.
- Behaviour stays as it is today: 8 of the new tests also pass on the current code.

**What I measured on my scratch copy** (outside `store/`):
- 613/613 covering tests pass, typecheck and Biome are clean, and all 6 mutants fail the tests they should.
- The perf spec ran alone on a production build: 103 rows equal to C round 332 and 18 lower. Trim goes 23.6 → 21.633 components per move, move 28.2 → 26.233, range 9.233 → 7.267, and a click drops from 3 commits to 2.
- The browser names probe shows only the extra detail-panel commits disappear; every other commit renders the same components.
- One thing to watch: the perf liveness check `hook-live` now reads 1 against its minimum of 1. It still passes; I recorded it as a signal, and this round doesn't touch the perf budgets.

**Consults.** `performance-optimizer` and `tech-lead` both said to start the check with the current values instead of `null`, which I did. Both said the PeakPath primitive-props idea should be its own stage (c2b-iii). `tech-lead`'s five extra test cases became DP38–DP42. `product-designer` and `ableton-arrangement-expert` weren't needed, since nothing visible or audible changes.

**Order after this:** the regression round, then c2b-iii, then c3 (waits for the architecture checkpoint if it's answered by then), c4 and c5, then the rest of the queue as before.

The advisor was available and used twice: before the approach and for the final review. Its one blocking fix (A-REVIEW must be required for 3 changed files) is applied. `store/` is unchanged and nothing was committed.
